_comment: Copy to orgs.json (gitignored) to analyse more than one org.
With a single org you can skip this entirely and use the SF_* vars in .env.
Nothing about an org is assumed by the code. Edition, API allowance,
Event Monitoring availability, Dependency API coverage and endpoint routing
are all DISCOVERED per org by `python scripts/probe_org.py <alias>` and
cached in the org_capabilities table. Point this at any org and it adapts.
Each org needs a Connected App with:
- a 'Run As' user assigned (Manage > Edit Policies)
The Run As user's permissions bound what the analysis can see, so a
System Administrator is strongly recommended - anything invisible to that
user is indistinguishable from something genuinely unused.
